decisions.reason: The margin analysis draws on the firm's core market-data assets, has its own page, and fits the announced platform strategy, so management attributes any weak uptake to ramp-up and persists.

The regional electricity tariff calculator sits close to the core offer, is visibly presented, and represents sunk development, so management keeps it despite the precedent set by dropping the gas comparison.
The multi-model energy tariff line was a substantial investment that management still justifies, though its low visibility and overlap with C and F make consolidation somewhat plausible.
The area definition tool underpins the other location-based products and the platform and has its own page, so withdrawing it would undercut prior commitments.
The site-specific comparison line resembles the dropped gas comparison and has only modest visibility, but its several models and fit with the core business lead management to persist for now.
